    """
    Extract algorithms defined via the custom macro:
        \\ulesalgorithm{<title>}{<body>}
    This macro is NOT a \\begin/\\end environment, so _extract_envs misses it.
    We generalise: match any \\<word>algorithm{title}{body} macro pattern.

    pattern = re.compile(
        r'\\(?P<macro>[A-Za-z]*[Aa]lgorithm)'
        r'\{(?P<title>[^{}]*)\}'          # title: no nested braces

        re.DOTALL
    )

        idx += 1
        obj_id = f'A{idx}'
        title = m.group('title').strip()
        body = m.group('body')
        label, _ = self._extract_label_and_name(body)
        clean_text = self._clean_latex_to_text(body)

        output_sig: Optional[str] = None
        m_in = re.search(r'Input\s*:?\s*(.*?)(?=Output\s*:|$)', clean_text, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)

            id=obj_id,
            kind='algorithm',
            index=idx,
            label=label,
            name=title if title else None,
            raw_latex=body,
            clean_text=clean_text,
            env_name=m.group('macro'),
        )
        alg._source_pos = m.start()
        objects.append(alg)
